inputs.incident_text: A customer noticed the homepage loaded 200ms slower than usual during peak hours. No errors reported, no user complaints filed.
The nightly batch export job failed silently last night and needs to be rerun manually; no downstream systems were affected since today's data hasn't been consumed yet.
The checkout API is returning 500 errors for roughly 15% of requests since 9am, and customers are unable to complete purchases intermittently.
The primary database ran out of disk space and all writes across the platform are currently failing. Every customer-facing service is down.
A single internal admin dashboard is showing a stale cache from two hours ago. No customer impact, engineering is aware and monitoring.
Authentication tokens are expiring 10 minutes early due to a clock drift on one server, causing some users to be logged out unexpectedly and needing to sign back in.
